name: Concorde
what_failed: Supersonic passenger aircraft that operated for 27 years but never achieved commercial viability.
why_it_failed: Fuel costs made tickets prohibitively expensive
assumptions_that_broke: Speed is the primary value proposition in air travel
Governments will subsidize prestige technology indefinitely
Regulatory environment would permit overland supersonic flight
constraints_that_moved: Video conferencing reduced business travel demand
lesson: A technology that violates the dominant constraint of its era (fuel cost, noise, emissions) will fail regardless of its engineering brilliance.
